$ labctl service list
NAME   PATH
pager  <lab>/src/services/pager

$ labctl service up pager
Installing service pager...
installing pager
Service pager installed.

$ labctl service status
--- pager ---
running


$ labctl service status pager
running

$ labctl service down pager
Uninstalling service pager...
removing pager
Service pager uninstalled.
